mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cal_meeting_room ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cal_meeting_room (name, capacity, location, equipment, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{capacity}, #{location}, #{equipment}, #{status})

INSERT INTO cal_event (title, event_type, room_id, organizer_id, organizer_name, start_time, end_time, attendees, remark) VALUES (#{title}, #{eventType}, #{roomId}, #{organizerId}, #{organizerName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{attendees}, #{remark})
